title: icp.scored event (v6.2 — the table scores)
description: One event per row, posted by the Clay ICP table to n8n Path B. It carries THE SCORE: the table classifies, enriches AND grades, and n8n writes. Eight required keys are what a write cannot happen without; twelve optional keys are the working, carried into the run summary and never into a decision. additionalProperties is false over exactly those twenty — a column the table starts sending that this list does not name is a contract change, and a contract change should be loud.

request_id.description: the n8n correlation id issued on Path A; the Path B dedupe key, on its own

org_id.description: numeric, as Pipedrive has it and as Path A sent it — it becomes a URL path segment on the PATCH

deal_id.description: present always; null is legal, because a re-score can happen outside a deal

status.description: "scored" REQUIRES a non-null final and grade; otherwise the organization would be given a grade-shaped blank

note.description: the table's own note, written to the Pipedrive activity VERBATIM. n8n renders nothing: there is one author of what a rep reads, and it is the table.
